closed_loop.right_kernel: on an invertible open-loop chart, x in ker(I-K_rel) lifts to psi=(x,G Bx) in ker C
closed_loop.determinant: the relative determinant of C is det(I-K_rel), with the bare Euler block entering the completed determinant line contravariantly

determinant_cofactor_edge.simple_zero: adj(C)=c psi tensor phi, where psi spans ker C and phi spans ker C^times
determinant_cofactor_edge.line_valued_version: the canonical cofactor is a section of ker(C) tensor ker(C^times) tensor the complementary determinant line; choosing c or normalized left/right vectors is not intrinsic

Green_edge.source_column: B_f:C->E, c maps to c f
Green_edge.metric_independence: B_f^times exists before any Hilbert Riesz map
Green_edge.Green_realization: a conservative rigging would map a right kernel state psi to a dual state lambda_psi in E' and evaluate B_f^times(lambda_psi)

triangle_equation.determinant_route: dot C_f -> cofactor_C(dot C_f)=<phi,dot C_f psi> in determinant-line notation
triangle_equation.required_identification: phi restricted to the forcing variation equals the rigged Green dual lambda_psi, including determinant-line normalization and reciprocal orientation

why_scalar_Xi_is_insufficient: Xi determines the determinant divisor and algebraic multiplicity but not the left-kernel covector phi. The Green forcing pairing requires exactly that missing covector. Two pencils can have the same Xi determinant and right-kernel dimension while carrying different left kernels and hence different forcing boundaries.

simple_vs_multiple.simple: identify the rank-one cofactor tensor psi tensor phi with psi tensor lambda_psi
simple_vs_multiple.multiple: identify the full determinant-line cofactor/minor complex with the dual Jordan/root-chain complex; ordinary adjugate may vanish and is insufficient

relation_to_residue: The diagonal residue tau A supplies a scalar exact boundary but no left-kernel covector. Its promotion to the R-D-G triangle requires A to be the evaluation of the determinant cofactor covector on the exponential homotopy variation, not merely an equal scalar function.
independence_condition: lambda_psi must come from the independently defined Green/test-dual pairing, while phi comes from the determinant cone. Proving they agree is the mate cell; defining one from the other would reproduce the independence failure of the synthetic Stokes G4.
next_iteration: At one finite cutoff and a simple zero, write the Schur left kernel explicitly. If phi_E is a left kernel of I-K_rel and phi_H is forced by the other block row, compare <phi,dot C_f psi> term-by-term with B_f^times(lambda_psi). This will expose the exact metric/domain coefficient that remains unsourced.
iteration_result: The first missing shared triangle is now analytically represented. It is not equality of two scalar readouts; it is equality between the determinant cone's left-kernel cofactor covector and the independently rigged Green dual of its right-kernel state. This is the precise 2-cell required before a literal 4-horn can form.
